messages:
Alex_Sales: FYI - EduCloud procurement escalation. They want a single PO that references our marketplace SKU but split costs across two internal entities (Platform BU + Central AP). They say their AP system requires distinct tax IDs per line. Can AWS Marketplace support per-line remit/tax IDs? :sweat_smile:

Mara_Procure: Marketplace vendors receive one invoice per marketplace account. Providers (AWS/GCP) won't emit two vendor lines with different vendor TINs. Customer can add multiple bill-to references internally, but vendor TIN on invoice will be ours. Short: marketplace won't satisfy per-line vendor tax id requirement.

Jin_Finance: If EduCloud insists their remit-to must match our contract entity for VAT reclaim, we have two paths: (1) direct commercial contract so we issue invoices to the requested remit-to entity OR (2) marketplace purchase with subsequent internal recharges. Both carry accounting overhead. Need to know if they need legal entity onboarding (W-9 / VAT docs) for the remit entity.

Alex_Sales: Customer says they prefer to stay on Marketplace for procurement speed but cannot accept invoices that lack their remit-to tax code per line. They asked whether we can accept a PO that lists both entities and then produce a supplemental invoice.

Sam_Eng: From product side: we can tag usage with arbitrary customer identifiers in Dedicated/Private but marketplace metering is controlled by provider. We can export SKU-level usage and add a mapping file to enable finance recharges. No way to change the marketplace invoice schema though.

Leo_SalesOps: Deal desk note: splitting commit discounts across entities impacts revenue recognition and our committed discount thresholds. We generally require a single contract entity for commit eligibility. Exception requests need RevOps approval and a signed carve-out. Please include proposed allocation percentages and the customer's justification for split.

Alex_Sales: Customer proposed 70% Platform BU / 30% Central AP. They want the PO processed this week to meet quarter start. I'll gather their AP contact and the signed PO. PO uploaded by ProcureBot: https://files.internal/redwood/EduCloud_PO_102938.pdf

Mara_Procure: Upload received. Checklist: (a) confirm PO number on marketplace invoice reference, (b) confirm customer's AP will accept marketplace invoice format with our VAT info, (c) get copy of both entities' TINs for their internal audit. If they can't accept, push for direct contract.

Jin_Finance: For the recharge flow we can accept a nightly SFTP CSV with invoice_line_id, usage_units, allocation_pct, target_entity. We can generate monthly credit memos but need deterministic mapping. Example row: `AWS-INV-2026-0101, sku-llm-l1, 10000, 70, EduCloud-Platform`. If they can't provide a nightly feed, finance can handle manual reconciliation for the first month only.

Sam_Eng: Engineering can deliver an SFTP export in ~3 weeks (auth + schema validations). Short-term: we'll provide a manual extract and help them with a template.

Leo_SalesOps: I'll prep the deal desk package. Alex, include: PO copy, allocation %, AP acceptance confirmation, and timeline. Also confirm whether the commit needs to be split on our rate card or we keep one commit on our ledger and do internal allocation on their side. If we split commit discount, legal needs to sign an amendment.

Alex_Sales: Copying procurement lead Claire Hu (claire.hu@educloud.com). Claire - can your AP accept marketplace invoice with our VAT and add PO number as reference? If not, do you prefer direct invoicing to Platform BU?

ProcureBot: Reminder: PO-102938 received at 2026-03-19T09:12:01Z. Link from earlier: https://files.internal/redwood/EduCloud_PO_102938.pdf

Claire_Hu (EduCloud): Hi all - AP can accept marketplace invoices if our PO number appears and your VAT number is present. However our tax team insists that the remit-to tax ID needs to be associated with the invoice lines for automated VAT reclaim. Is there a way to add a supplementary vendor invoice after purchase?

Jin_Finance: We can issue a supplementary invoice (credit/debit memo) after the marketplace invoice but it won't change who the marketplace lists as the vendor. That may still satisfy their reclaim process in some jurisdictions but not all. We need to know the country and specific VAT reclaim rules. Claire - what country is the reclaim against?

Claire_Hu (EduCloud): EduCloud is EU-headquartered (DE). VAT reclaim rules are strict. We will accept a supplementary invoice only if it includes your EU VAT and an invoice address matching Redwood's EU branch. Can you provide EU VAT and address?

Mara_Procure: Legal & tax confirm we have an EU entity with VAT ID: EU-987654321 and EU address: 5th Floor, 20 Inference St, Dublin, IE. I'll confirm offline before sending to the customer. :lock:

Alex_Sales: Plan proposed to the customer: 1) Short-term: proceed via AWS Marketplace with PO-102938, we will add PO number to marketplace invoice reference and provide a monthly manual allocation CSV for March. 2) Concurrent: finance will issue supplementary invoice from our EU entity with EU VAT and address for EU VAT reclaim; will aim to deliver within 10 business days. 3) Medium-term: engineering will enable nightly SFTP allocation feed to automate credit memos. Claire - does that work for you?

Claire_Hu (EduCloud): That covers our needs if the EU supplementary invoice is accepted for VAT reclaim. Please include our PO number and line allocation in the supplementary invoice. If any legal docs are needed for EU entity validation, let me know.

Leo_SalesOps: I'll submit to deal desk for carve-out approval for the split allocation and note the EU supplementary invoice approach as mitigation. Expect feedback by EOD tomorrow.

Alex_Sales: Thanks everyone. I'll attach the memo + proposed allocation and ping Leo when done. :thumbsup:
